Specialization.Name: Commodore (reSpecialized) 1.31
Specialization.Description: [H4]Commodore (reSpecialized)[h4] [B]COMMODORE—CAPITOL COMMAND[b][BR] [B]At a Glance[b][BR] The Commodore is a bit of a misnomer, as the title would presume a literal command or rank. In reality, Commodore covers the full gamut of command, tactical, and technical positions that would find themself stationed on the bridge or command deck of a capital ship. The Commodore is the captain, the helmsman, or the technical officer, potentially all three.[BR] [B]All-in or Hybrid?[b][BR] ¼ Generic “Capital Ship Leadership” ⅛ Damage Management (Education) ⅛ Systems Management (Computers) ⅛ Navigation (Outer Rim & Astrogation) ¼ Astrogation (Duh)[b][BR] [B]What Should it be the Best At?[b][BR] Helming and Command of Capital Ships[BR] [B]What should it be just “good” at?[b][BR] Leadership[BR] General Computers & Knowledge[BR] [B]Specs for Comparison / Inspiration[b][BR] [I]Tactician[i](The Tactician is a Operational-level army leader, so they are obviously more about managing planetary warfare and infantry/armor)[BR] [I]Ship Captain[i](Ship Captains are more about their ship, and generally are about trade, social skills, and bolstering the party passively. The Commodore is more of a technical role in addition to being a leader.)[BR] [I]Republic Navy Officer[i](The Republic Navy Officer is a little more aggressive than the Commodore, who is a more balanced, utility oriented leader)[BR] [B]Media Touchstones[b][BR] Admiral Ackbar (Episode VI: Return of the Jedi)[BR] Admiral Raddus (Rogue One)[BR] Captain John Sheridan (Babylon 5)[BR] Commander Susan Ivonova (Babylon 5)[BR] Admiral Adama (Battlestar Galactica)[BR]
